components.name: Documentary Photo
components.description: Square-edged full-bleed photograph graded near-monochrome so the centre pillar keeps the colour.

narrative.overview:
The whole system is built from one image: a stage seen through eleven vertical pillars, ten monochrome and the centre one in colour, 27% taller and capped with a gold edge. Everything else is quiet so that image carries the brand: matte black and ivory alternate as full-width fields, type is large, light and tightly set, edges are square, and colour is withheld except at the culmination.

The register is a premium design house rather than a party band: low density, generous pacing, long left-aligned measures, and exactly one unprompted motion (the living stage: pillars rising on load, footage inside them, colour drifting while nobody steers). All other motion answers the visitor, starting with colour following the pointer over the stage.

Photography is documentary and graded near-monochrome so the only full colour on screen belongs to the hero stage: its centre pillar and the pillar the visitor lights.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating ink and ivory sections, flat, no gradients
Inter Tight Light display with negative tracking; Manrope text
Square buttons and fields; circles only for play and timeline markers
Gold only at culmination or in response to action

rules.name: The Culmination Rule
rules.body: Gold marks the end of a sequence or the answer to an action: the mark's beam, the centre pillar, the last process step, a hover. Gold at rest anywhere else is wrong.

rules.name: The Two Fields Rule
rules.body: Sections are ink or ivory edge to edge. No third surface, no tints, no gradients, no red, blue or violet.

rules.name: The Held Colour Rule
rules.body: Photography is graded near-monochrome so the hero stage (the centre pillar and the pillar under the pointer) is the only full colour on the page.

rules.name: The Light Voice Rule
rules.body: Display and headlines are weight 300 with -0.035 to -0.04em tracking; 500 is reserved for titles and buttons; nothing is bold.

rules.name: The Single Capitals Rule
rules.body: Tracked uppercase exists only in the logotype.

rules.name: The Flat Stage Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never float; separate with a field change or a 1px rule, not a shadow.

dos: Do alternate full-bleed ink and ivory sections and keep every surface flat.
Do set headlines in Inter Tight 300 with negative tracking and let them be large.
Do grade every photograph with the documentary treatment (92% grayscale, 1.06 contrast).
Do reserve gold for culminations and responses to action.
Do keep stage band geometry in lockstep with the Remotion render.
Do use the 2px gold focus outline with 3px offset on every interactive element.
Do use circles only for play affordances and timeline or diagram markers.
donts: Don't use red, blue or violet, gradients, or decorative fonts.
Don't put gold on a field, a heading or body copy at rest.
Don't round buttons, inputs or image frames.
Don't add drop shadows or floating cards.
Don't use tracked uppercase outside the logotype, and don't add arrows to buttons.
Don't add a second unprompted animation.
Don't introduce logo walls, stat counters, or dark washes over full-bleed party photos.
